business_problem: FOX wanted to reimagine how audiences, advertisers, and broadcasters interact with media by using generative AI, machine learning, and data to create more relevant experiences at the scale of hundreds of millions of monthly users.
solution_summary: FOX built AI-driven media products on AWS to turn audience and content data into near-real-time insights for consumers, advertisers, and broadcasters. The company uses Amazon SageMaker for machine learning workflows, Amazon Personalize to tailor experiences, and is exploring Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Titan for newer generative AI capabilities. This stack helps FOX accelerate data insight generation and produce contextually relevant products across brands such as FOX Sports, Tubi, FOX Entertainment, and FOX News. By combining personalization, predictive models, and emerging foundation-model services on AWS, FOX is treating data and AI as a core part of how viewers discover and engage with media.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker
solution_components.role: Supports training, fine-tuning, and managed inference for machine learning workloads.

solution_components.name: Amazon Personalize
solution_components.role: Generates personalized recommendations and contextual experiences from behavioral data.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Provides foundation-model access for generative AI features and assistants.

solution_components.name: Amazon Titan
solution_components.role: Supplies foundation models for customer-facing generative AI features.

data_flow: Audience and content data feeds machine learning and personalization services on AWS, which generate near-real-time insights and AI-driven experiences for FOX consumer, advertiser, and broadcaster products.
business_outcome: Using AWS, FOX is accelerating data insights to deliver AI-driven products in near real time that are contextually relevant and highly valuable to consumers, advertisers, and broadcasters alike.
metrics: It has over 300 million monthly active users, meaning over 300 million people see one or more pieces of content on FOX every month.
